title: The Smiling Bell
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Elodie Montrose, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
